title: 巴克莱印度CEO：权益融资每年超500亿美元，散户与资管支撑市场
speaker: Pramod Kumar

segments.en: So, you know, it's really supporting these strong GDP growth. The same time it seems like it's, I mean, the market has struggled a bit. The equity market itself, but there seems to be this disconnect that I hear from what happening in private capital versus public.
segments.zh: 这支撑了强劲的GDP增长。同时市场似乎有些挣扎，权益市场本身，私募与公募之间似乎存在脱节。

segments.en: I mean, how do you see sentiment now when it comes to this market? Look, if you look at last couple of years, India has, you know, if you combine all forms of sort of equity capital, right, it's been over $50 billion plus each of these years.
segments.zh: 你怎么看当前市场情绪？过去几年，印度各类权益资本合计每年超过500亿美元。

segments.en: This year's again, it's been pretty strong. So, you know, I think, I see barring sort of some ups and downs, structurally India will continue to see strong capital raising environment.
segments.zh: 今年依然强劲。我认为除了一些起伏，印度结构上将继续保持强劲的融资环境。

segments.en: They've been few IPOs. There were price very aggressively that are trading below the price so that that affects some sentiments, but overall, I would see the amount of capital that's going in from individuals through SIPs and, you know, large amount of assets that are asset managers are managing.
segments.zh: 有些IPO定价激进，目前跌破发行价，影响了一些情绪。但整体看，个人通过定投投入的资金，以及资管机构管理的大量资产，仍在支撑。

segments.en: I think they continue to support, despite FBI's, you know, pulling out of the market.
segments.zh: 我认为它们继续提供支撑，尽管外资在撤出市场。
